set.body:
Goal
Use the four study presentations as a response-blind real positive control before interpreting retrieval.

Design
Score prespecified P1-to-P2, P1-to-P3, P1-to-P4, and adjacent-presentation comparisons; contrast true-image candidates against held-out wrong images; add temporal reversal and shuffle controls that preserve coordinates and density. Reuse the full-cohort support and court definitions finalized in GW-15.

Acceptance criteria
- Participant and item folds, candidate panels, registration, and uncertainty are shared by every method.
- Transport v3 shows positive held-out item information on intact repeated viewing and a prospectively declared intact-over-reversed/order-shuffled contrast.
- The repetition trajectory is reported without assuming it must increase; any habituation-related decline remains descriptive.
- Compare density sigma 80/160, registered density, stabilized Replay, Transport v2, MultiMatch dimensions, and the learned MultiMatch composite.
- Crossed participant/item bootstrap intervals, calibration, identification, convergence, and runtime are reported.
- No retrieval response, correctness, confidence, or saliency value is opened or used during this gate.
- A negative or merely tied result is retained and advances only under the GW-18.1 decision rule.
set.title: GW-18.9 Establish Transport v3 sensitivity on the study repeated-viewing ceiling
